newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Super Group says negotiating acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Super Group says negotiating acquisitions.

text.p: Super Group Ltd, formerly known as Motolink, said on Tuesday it was negotiating the acquisition of a company earning U.S. dollar denominated revenue flows.
A limited due diligence investigation into the company was currently underway and was expected to be completed in February, Super Group said in a statement.
The company added that it was considering combining the acquisition with the possible purchase of Alex Carriers (Pty) Ltd, a leading South African long distance haulage operator.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their dealings pending further announcements.
